questions.stemHtml: A 25-year-old patient comes with recurrent vesicular rash on lips. Soon he develops a pruritic rash that began on the extremities especially the palms and soles and then spreads on the trunk. He was given acyclovir for the same. Her temperature is 38.1 °C. Examination of the skin lesions reveals dusky center and a lighter color around it. The final outer area appears to be erythematous. Which of the following is the likely diagnosis?
